mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth expectations improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 300,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and consumer sentiment (proxied by RSAFS) also increases by more than 5% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM increase > 10% and RSAFS MoM increase > 5%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between HOUST and RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek higher returns.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with low interest rates
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL conditions and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between UNRATE decreases, PAYEMS increases, and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
